oracle: live Wikidot edit/PagePreviewModule plus run-owned template pages created and deleted on sandbox-for-codex

observations: The module renders a div.new-page-box wrapper with inline style text-align: center; margin: 1em 0.
The form action is dummy.html, method is get, and onsubmit calls WIKIDOT.modules.NewPageHelperModule.listeners.create(event).
The page-name field is input.text name=pageName type=text size=30 maxlength=128 style=margin: 1px.
The default submit button is value 'Create page', capitalized, not the documentation-derived lowercase 'create page'.

cases.source: [[module NewPage size="30" category="band" parent="bands" tags="rock" button="Add a new rock band"]]
observations: A non-empty category attribute renders hidden input name=categoryName.
A non-empty tags attribute renders hidden input name=tags.
A non-empty parent attribute renders hidden input name=parent.
The button attribute overrides the submit value exactly after HTML attribute escaping.
The format attribute renders hidden input name=format when non-empty.
The mode attribute renders hidden input name=mode for any non-empty value, including documented autosave modes and invalid values.
The goTo attribute renders hidden input name=goTo only when mode is also present and non-empty.

cases.source: [[module NewPage size="999" button="   " SIZE="15" button='ignored' category=doc]]
observations: NewPage recognized attributes are exact-case, not case-insensitive: SIZE is ignored.
NewPage uses double-quoted values; bare values and single-quoted values are ignored in observed cases.
Duplicate recognized attributes use the last recognized double-quoted value.
size="0" and size="" fall back to 30, but negative, non-numeric, whitespace-padded, and large values are echoed into the size attribute.
button="" falls back to Create page, but whitespace-only button values are preserved.

Despite the documentation saying _default cannot be used as a category, live rendering still emits hidden input name=categoryName value=_default. Any rejection is deferred to the create action rather than the module renderer.
A single existing template page in the template: category renders hidden input name=template whose value is the template page id.
Two or more existing templates render a select name=template before the submit input.
The first option is value="" selected="selected" with visible text '-- Select a template --'.
Each template option value is the page id and visible text is the template page title.
A missing template renders div.error-block with text Template "<template>" can not be found.
An existing template argument outside the template: category renders div.error-block with text "<page>" is not in the "template:" category.
